impostor-io.title: Play Impostor.io Online - Multiplayer Social Deduction Game
impostor-io.slogan: Unmask the Impostors, Complete Tasks, and Survive!
impostor-io.description: Impostor.io is an engaging multiplayer game inspired by the popular social deduction game Among Us. In this exciting experience, players find themselves on a spaceship where they must work together to complete tasks and identify the impostors among them. Impostor.io offers a thrilling blend of strategy and deception, making it perfect for fans of social deduction games. Join the adventure and see if you can uncover the impostors or successfully deceive your crewmates. Play Impostor.io now and experience the suspense!
